risk_summary: The excerpt presents meaningful operating and credit risks from pandemic aftereffects, labor shortages, inflation, low nursing-home occupancy, customer cash-flow issues, and increased bad-debt provisions. It provides useful revenue, customer-count, and allowance quantification, but relies substantially on standard forward-looking disclaimers and broad, non-exhaustive risk language. Elevated insurance-retention exposure and actuarial uncertainty further constrain risk transparency.
